code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); frames=[]
    for c in range(1,10):
        pts=[(r,x) for r in range(h) for x in range(w) if grid[r][x]==c]
        if not pts: continue
        r0=min(r for r,x in pts); r1=max(r for r,x in pts); x0=min(x for r,x in pts); x1=max(x for r,x in pts)
        # rectangular boundary color
        if all(grid[r0][x]==c and grid[r1][x]==c for x in range(x0,x1+1)) and all(grid[r][x0]==c and grid[r][x1]==c for r in range(r0,r1+1)):
            ir,ix=r1-r0-1,x1-x0-1
            if ir>0 and ix>0:
                inside=[[grid[r][x] for x in range(x0+1,x1)] for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
                frames.append((c,r0,x0,r1-r0+1,x1-x0+1,inside,any(v!=0 for row in inside for v in row)))
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for src in frames:
        if not src[6]: continue
        for dst in frames:
            if dst[6] or dst[0]==src[0]: continue
            if (dst[3],dst[4])!=(src[3],src[4]): continue

            for a in range(hh-2):
                for b in range(ww-2):
                    if pat[a][b]!=0: out[dst[1]+1+a][dst[2]+1+b]=dst[0]
    return out
'''
